summary: ITER-78 four-item batch fully verified end-to-end. (1) Signup v3 two-column layout — at 1440x900 the persona-first form card renders on LEFT (signup-role-caregiver X=173) and compact plan picker on RIGHT (signup-plan-family X=835). Submit button lands at Y=944 (just 44px below the 900px fold — essentially ~1x viewport as spec'd). signup-caregiver-fields is default-visible (caregiver is the default role) and correctly hides when toggling to participant. Mobile field is behind a collapsed <details> summary 'Add a mobile number (optional)' and reveals on click. At 375x667, plans stack ABOVE the form (plan Y=353 < form Y=898) — the order-1/order-2 swap works. Zero console errors on /signup. (2) Report Persona Refresh — verified via NEW /app/backend/tests/test_iter78_report_persona_refresh.py. Cathy generates HOUSEHOLD_SUMMARY as caregiver → exec_summary opens with 'Dorothy has used just under half of her quarterly budget so far…' (third person). Then PUT /api/persona switches her to participant, and a fresh generation yields 'You've used 49% of your quarterly budget with BlueBerry Care this quarter…' — no Dorothy leakage, dominant second-person 'you/your'. This proves the report.pop('_persona_context', None) + fresh load_persona_context() at reports_routes.py:1158 landed correctly (stale persona is dropped before each generation). (3) LF-1 adaptive system-prompt trim — _build_user_message no longer emits the PERSONA CONTEXT block; caregiver dispute letter still produced third-person 'Dorothy' body (persona injection still flowing via system prompt in generate_letter → confirms it's not double-emitted). (4) Copy governance lint — the two structural pytests in tests/test_persona_governance.py both pass. Verified their teeth by injecting: (a) a probe JSX file with Python-style adjacent strings → test FAILED with 'frontend/src/pages/_governance_probe.jsx:3'; (b) a temp 'test.orphan.key' in TIER1_VARIANTS → test FAILED with 'test.orphan.key' called out by name. Both probes removed and re-run confirms clean state. Backend regression suite: 34/34 persona base + 1 new persona-refresh = 35/35 pass. Iter77 LF-1 participant letter has ONE flaky assertion — see minor issues below.

minor.issue: tests/test_iter77_persona_injection.py::TestLF1PersonaVoice::test_participant_letter_uses_first_person asserts "'dorothy' not in body" AFTER passing intake={'participant_name': 'Dorothy'}. The LLM correctly rendered 'I am writing to dispute a charge on Dorothy's May statement' — the letter voice IS first-person (persona flow works), but the LLM echoed the intake field. Test should either: (a) set participant_name='Cathy' (or omit it) when running the participant case, OR (b) assert only that first-person voice is present rather than requiring absence of the intake name. Not a persona-injection regression.

issues: Submit button top-edge sits at Y=944 (44px below the 900px fold). Meets the spec's 'within scroll distance (~1x viewport)' requirement, but the review copy says 'both above the fold' — strictly true only for the plan picker (Y=104–1057) and the form header (Y=402 for the role radio). The submit button itself does require a tiny scroll. Consider slimming the header block ~50px if 'submit-above-fold' is the hard requirement.

action_items: (minor) Iter77 test bug: tests/test_iter77_persona_injection.py::TestLF1PersonaVoice::test_participant_letter_uses_first_person is flaky when intake.participant_name='Dorothy' — LLM correctly echoes the intake name and trips the 'dorothy not in body' assertion. Either drop that assertion for the participant case or override the intake participant name to 'Cathy'/self for the participant run.

(review) Copy Governance Lint suite is currently pytest-only. As the misc note suggests, wire tests/test_persona_governance.py::test_no_adjacent_string_literals_in_jsx into a pre-commit hook (or CI-required check) so the CE-2-style build break is impossible to reintroduce at PR time — pytest running only after PR merge is the wrong quality gate for a build-blocker.

(design) At 1440x900, Signup v3 submit button falls ~44px below the fold. If 'both submit + plans above the fold' is a hard requirement rather than a soft one, trim the top hero/header block by ~50–60px.
critical_code_review_comments: reports_routes.py:1158 pop-before-reload of _persona_context is CORRECT for retries, but note the fresh-generation path (POST /api/reports/generate) never populates _persona_context in the initial insert anyway — the pop is defensive-programming for the retry path where a stale ctx might have been serialized alongside a FAILED report. Consider adding a comment explicitly calling out that this pop is only strictly needed on retry.

services/lf1_generate.py:_build_user_message keeps `persona_context` on the signature for API stability but assigns it to `_` — clean, but a callsite grepping for persona_context will now find dead usage. Add a comment noting that the block is intentionally emitted via generate_letter's system-prompt path only.

lib/persona/registry.py comment on line 213-218 references retired seed keys but doesn't list them explicitly. Consider naming the retired keys (lf1.letter.rate_query.opening, lf1.signature.representative, reports.summary.intro) in the comment so future git-archaeology doesn't have to scan history.

tests/test_persona_governance.py::_ADJACENT_JSX_PATTERN uses a simple `"..."\n..."..."` regex; it will not catch adjacent strings on the SAME line (e.g. `foo: "a" "b"`) or triple-quoted TS templates. Confirmed the CE-2 root cause was multi-line so today's suite catches it, but the pattern could be tightened to a token-level scan in a follow-up.
